items.title: CFTC clears stock perpetual futures for trading on US exchanges
items.summary: US regulators are opening the door to stock-based perpetual futures.

items.title: CZ calls for crypto security alliance as AI-driven attacks accelerate after Binance hack
items.summary: Changpeng Zhao says AI is accelerating cyberattacks and calls for industry security alliance.

items.title: Binance traces $6.3B hack to fake job interviews, compromised AI tool
items.summary: Hackers exploited compromised employee computers and stolen credentials to breach Binance's wallet infrastructure.

items.title: Brazil's Biggest Bitcoin Exchange Says It Will Refund Users After a $40 Million Hack
items.summary: Mercado Bitcoin says customers won't pay for a hack that drained tens of millions. Withdrawals remain frozen.

items.title: Binance's $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview, and a campaign 'built over many months'
items.summary: North Korea-linked attackers spent months compromising Binance employees before exploiting hot-wallet infrastructure.

items.title: Binance Says $6.34 Billion Hack Began With Fake Job Interview
items.summary: Binance's incident report says the $6.34 billion Oct. 29 theft was a five-month campaign.

items.title: North Korea denies role in $6 billion Binance hack after FBI accusation
items.summary: Reuters, citing KCNA, reported the denial after the FBI blamed TraderTraitor for stealing more than $6 billion from Binance.

items.title: Binance says hackers used fake job interview, internal AI tool in $6.3 billion breach
items.summary: Binance's incident report said hackers used a fake job interview and an internal AI tool to gain access.

items.title: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in 'political gridlock'
items.summary: Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.

items.title: Bitcoin and Treasury yields fall together in rare divergence as $80,000 recovery fails
items.summary: November 2 ETF redemptions add a demand concern as Bitcoin's latest decline follows a drop in real yields.

items.title: Tether Holds 150,000 Bitcoin CEO Says, 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Shows
items.summary: Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said in Lugano that the company holds 150,000 Bitcoin.

items.title: CFTC clears perpetual futures on stocks, bringing crypto trading model to Wall Street
items.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig said the move gives U.S. traders a regulated alternative to offshore venues.

items.title: CFTC approves individual stock perpetual futures trading in US for the first time
items.summary: The CFTC approved the ability for exchanges in the U.S. to offer perpetual futures contracts tied to individual stocks.

items.title: CFTC Lets Traders Bet on Stocks With Crypto-Style Perpetual Futures
items.summary: Chairman Michael Selig said equity perpetual futures can now trade on CFTC-registered exchanges.

items.title: US midterms: Prediction markets favor Democrats in key crypto races
items.summary: Kalshi and Polymarket price a 75% chance of a Democratic sweep.

items.title: Prediction markets bet on Democratic sweep of House, Senate in midterm elections
items.summary: Bettors on prediction markets are increasingly pricing in Democrats taking both the House and Senate.

items.title: TD Cowen: Democratic Congress Would Sink CLARITY Act for Two Years
items.summary: TD Cowen's Jaret Seiberg says a Democratic sweep of Congress would kill the CLARITY Act.

items.title: Crypto spent $55 million defending a senator who already backed CLARITY
items.summary: Defend American Jobs, a crypto-backed political group, spent more than $55 million supporting Republican Jon Husted.
